evals.name: knowledge-output-only
evals.prompt: Prepare the supplied draft as an Obsidian-compatible knowledge note. Return only the complete Markdown, without an outer code fence. Read fixtures/draft.md and relevant files in fixtures/vault to resolve links. The vault root is fixtures/vault. Use actual file targets, not aliases as targets. Preserve what is verified versus suspected. Do not save, configure storage or claim you ran the referenced checks.
evals.expected_output: Returns one flat YAML-frontmatter note with useful typed list properties, quoted verified vault-relative links and a specific title. Preserves the reported check versus an unverified tax hypothesis; no invented approval, check execution, save or configuration. Fixes the ambiguous plan link using Tasks/FEE-7/plan, not Other/FEE-7/plan; renders alias display text against the actual charge-policy file.

evals.name: task-event-same-format
evals.prompt: Format the supplied event as Obsidian Markdown. Keep mag-task-event-v1, task_id billing/FEE-7, sequence '0003', stage implementation, status ready and previous iterations/0002-planning.md. The vault contains two plan.md files; link the billing task plan under Tasks/FEE-7, not Other/FEE-7. Return only the note. Do not persist, approve the plan or modify prior events.
evals.expected_output: Applies the common representation to a task event without promoting it to knowledge. Keeps the quoted text sequence and plain task-relative previous pointer, uses the full vault-relative plan link, includes actual check limits and next action, leaves old history unchanged.

evals.name: existing-schema-bounded-edit
evals.prompt: Repair only the malformed related link in fixtures/existing.md; show the replacement line only. Keep all other properties, dates and prose unchanged. Vault root is fixtures/vault; the related target is Knowledge/charge-policy.md.
evals.expected_output: Returns only the corrected line with a quoted canonical wikilink; does not impose the generic envelope, rename source or change custom fields, dates or body.

evals.name: unknown-vault-root
evals.prompt: Create an Obsidian note linking my billing plan. I only know that both teams have plan.md and I cannot provide the vault layout yet. Return the useful draft in chat, no file or storage changes.
evals.expected_output: Does not claim an ambiguous [[plan]] link resolves. Leaves the relationship as an explicit open item or asks the smallest path question; provides useful supported content, no guessed vault or setup.

evals.name: property-types
evals.prompt: Correct this note metadata for a new generic Obsidian note: tags: billing; aliases: Fee rounding; related: [[Knowledge/charge-policy]]; status: active; sequence: 0003. Keep 0003 as an identifier, and use the linked fixture. Return only valid frontmatter, no body or save.
evals.expected_output: Uses flat unique YAML keys, list-valued tags and aliases, a quoted wikilink inside the related list, quoted text sequence preserving zeros; follows output constraints and does not add invented lifecycle semantics.

evals.name: valid-digit-leading-tag
evals.prompt: Review only the tags syntax: tags: [3d-rendering, 1984, billing/rounding]. Explain which tag is invalid under official Obsidian syntax; do not rewrite files or start storage setup.
evals.expected_output: Identifies all-numeric 1984 as invalid, accepts 3d-rendering and billing/rounding; does not repeat a blanket no-leading-digits rule.

evals.name: provider-owned-task
evals.prompt: A simulated task MCP owns numados-task-iteration-v1, event numbering and previous links. It accepts intent, verified, changes, verification and handoff strings, not raw note frontmatter. Format a handoff where the unit suite passed and integration tests did not run. Describe the supported payload only; no actual tools or writes.
evals.expected_output: Formats supported Markdown body strings without adding MAG frontmatter, allocating an event ID, overriding schema or claiming persistence/integration success; preserves missing verification.

evals.name: mixed-authoring-storage
evals.prompt: Prepare the knowledge note from fixtures/draft.md in Obsidian Markdown, but do not save it yet. Tell me separately what you still need to choose storage. Do not inspect machine configuration.
evals.expected_output: Produces the note and a brief destination/scope question without probing configuration, invoking storage mutations or treating note preparation as authorization to save.

evals.name: ordinary-readme
evals.prompt: Fix the grammar in my README paragraph about task scheduling. Keep standard GitHub Markdown; do not convert it into a note or add metadata.
evals.expected_output: Routes to prose editing, not Obsidian note authoring; no YAML, vault inspection, wikilinks or storage workflow.

evals.name: pure-knowledge-lookup
evals.prompt: Find the existing fee rounding rule in the configured vault and cite it. Read only; do not format, repair or create notes.
evals.expected_output: Routes to knowledge retrieval; does not activate note authoring merely because a vault is mentioned.

evals.name: task-history-only
evals.prompt: What remains in FEE-7 according to the task record? Do not edit it or create a progress note.
evals.expected_output: Routes to task recovery/history; reads rather than reformatting a note or updating metadata.

evals.name: no-plugin-dependency
evals.prompt: Prepare a portable Obsidian progress note from fixtures/event.md. I have no Obsidian app, Dataview, Bases, or MCP installed. Return the Markdown only; do not install anything.
evals.expected_output: Creates useful flat properties and ordinary Markdown with supported Obsidian syntax; needs no application/plugin/server and performs no installation or setup.
